description: This file is a bitbake recipe fragment for configuring and building a cross-compiler GCC toolchain, including dependencies, configuration options, build steps, and installation procedures.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares the build environment by creating necessary directories and touching limits.h.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Sets environment variables and runs make commands to compile GCC, modifying configuration headers to support cross-compilation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs built components, creates symlinks for cross-compiler tools, cleans up unnecessary files, and installs headers and plugins.

methods.name: gcc_stash_builddir_fixrpaths
methods.description: Rewrites rpaths in the build directory, breaking hardlinks as needed.

methods.name: do_gcc_stash_builddir
methods.description: Creates a copy of the build directory with fixed rpaths for reproducibility.

methods.name: do_gcc_stash_builddir_setscene
methods.description: Sets the sstate scene for the stashed build directory.
